statBlock.name: Detached Shadow
statBlock.description: A detached silhouette brought to life by the Scissors of Shadow Snipping. Endelyn uses these shadows as spies.

sections.Damage resistances: Acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder, and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained.
sections.Traits:
Amorphous. It can move through openings as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.
Shadow Stealth. In dim light or darkness, its Stealth bonus is +6 and it can Hide as a bonus action.
Sunlight Weakness. In sunlight, its attacks, ability checks, and saving throws have disadvantage.
sections.Actions: Strength Drain. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 9 (2d6 + 2) necrotic damage and reduces the target’s Strength score by 1d4. If the score reaches 0, the target falls unconscious. A short or long rest restores the lost Strength and ends unconsciousness caused by this drain.
sections.Shadow Snipping: Use this stat block when the wielder of the Scissors of Shadow Snipping releases the shadow to act independently. The shadowless creature is cursed. Ending that curse or reducing the detached shadow to 0 hit points makes the detached shadow vanish and restores the creature’s ordinary shadow.
sections.Motherhorn theater: Eleven detached shadows in M10 are invisible while hiding in the shadows of the scenery. Moving the scenery reveals them. They attack only when threatened.
sections.Printed source: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight, pp. 30, 140, 159, and 213 (Scissors of Shadow Snipping and adventure encounters), with the Shadow from Monster Manual (2014), p. 269.

statBlock.name: Skylla
statBlock.description: A warlock of Baba Yaga also known as Charmay. A warning from Endelyn drove her out of the League of Malevolence and into Motherhorn.

sections.Traits: Special Equipment. Her Eldritch Staff holds up to 10 charges and restores 1d6 + 4 spent charges at dawn. When she spends its final charge, roll a d20. A 1 destroys the staff.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Eldritch Staff attacks. Skylla can substitute Spellcasting for one attack.
Eldritch Staff. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage, or 4 (1d8) with two hands. On the hit, Skylla can spend up to 3 staff charges. Each adds 4 (1d8) lightning damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell with Charisma (save DC 13), with no material components.
1/day each. Detect Magic, Disguise Self, Faerie Fire, Fly, Hypnotic Pattern, Invisibility, Mage Armor.
sections.Reactions: Eldritch Escape. When Skylla takes damage, she can spend 3 staff charges. She becomes invisible and teleports with her equipment to a visible unoccupied space within 60 ft. The invisibility ends at the start of her next turn or earlier if she attacks, casts a spell, or deals damage.
sections.Motherhorn workshop: The command word nocturli animates the eight props in M12. Use Animated Armor for each, with AC 19 for the stovepipe and gate, AC 15 for the coffin and wooden owlbear, AC 13 for the plaster elf king and cake, and AC 11 for the boar mannequin and stuffed golem. While they fight, Skylla takes Golmo and retreats toward the darklings in M2. If forced to surrender, she can say alfarian to return the props to normal.
sections.Printing note: The printed block gives AC 13 with Mage Armor and ends Eldritch Escape when Skylla deals damage. The local index omits both details.
sections.Printed source: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight, pp. 160 and 220 (M12 and Appendix B).

statBlock.name: Squirt the Oilcan
statBlock.description: A rusty oilcan animated during a Feywild party. Refill it with slippery boggle oil and it can guide the party from Thither to Yon.

sections.Traits:
False Appearance. When combat starts, Squirt rolls initiative with advantage if it is motionless. Anyone who has yet to see it move or act needs a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to recognize that it is animate.
Unusual Nature. Squirt needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
Boggle Oil (3 applications). Spend one application to spill a 10-ft. square of slippery, nonflammable oil on the ground within 5 ft. The oil is difficult terrain and lasts 1 hour. A creature that enters it or starts its turn there makes a DC 11 Dexterity save or falls prone. Boggles are unaffected.
sections.Refilling the oilcan: Squirt has too little oil to use the action when found at Little Oak. It stores up to three applications of slippery Boggle oil indefinitely. A character can spend 1 minute collecting 1d3 applications from a Boggle’s slippery puddle before it evaporates. A friendly Boggle supplies three applications for a small gift. An indifferent Boggle expects a more valuable gift. A hostile Boggle cooperates only if captured and compelled.
sections.Printed source: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight, pp. 110 and 119 (Squirt and the Boggle Oil sidebar).

statBlock.name: Strongheart
statBlock.description: The founder of Valor’s Call, a paladin who prefers to take villains alive. He carries the sentient longsword Steel.

sections.Traits: Special Equipment. Steel is a sentient, lawful good +2 longsword.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Steel attacks.
Steel. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) with two hands. Once on each of his turns when he hits, Strongheart can make the blade flare and leave the target blinded until the start of his next turn.
Revivify (recharges at dawn). Strongheart casts Revivify by touching the target with Steel.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast one listed spell with Charisma (save DC 13).
3/day each. Command, Detect Evil and Good, Protection from Evil and Good.
1/day each. Lesser Restoration, Remove Curse, Zone of Truth.
sections.Reactions: Protect Another. When an attacker Strongheart can see attacks another creature within 5 ft. of him, Strongheart can impose disadvantage on that roll if he is carrying his shield.
sections.Palace rescue: Strongheart is frozen in time with 20 hit points, 60 ft. above the storm vortex. As an action, free him by touching him with a unicorn horn and speaking his true name. Secure him with a rope first or catch him with a DC 15 Strength check to prevent the fall. He weighs 240 pounds with his gear. Steel cannot be removed, communicate, or cast Revivify while frozen.
sections.Storm vortex: A creature that falls into the vortex takes 18 (4d8) force damage, then takes it again at the start of its turns until it escapes. Its speed is 0 and cannot be increased, and others cannot see it. Ending a turn in the vortex with 0 hit points destroys the creature and scatters its remains and gear across the planes. An ally can lower a rope and pull it out.
sections.Printed source: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight, pp. 181, 201, 214, and 228 (P13, P47, Steel, and Appendix B).

statBlock.name: Swarm of Campestris
statBlock.classification: Medium swarm of Tiny plants, unaligned
statBlock.description: A cluster of singing mushrooms with speckled red or purple caps. They mimic any song they hear and dance around musicians.

sections.Languages: Understands Common. It speaks only through Mimicry.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, stunned.
sections.Traits:
Mimicry. Each campestri can imitate a voice or song it has heard, in a nasal falsetto.
Swarm. The swarm and another creature can share space. The swarm fits through any gap an individual Campestri can pass through. It cannot heal or gain temporary hit points.
sections.Actions:
Head Butts. Melee weapon attack, +0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (4d4) bludgeoning damage, or 5 (2d4) while the swarm is at half its maximum hit points or less.
Spores (1/day). Spores spread 20 ft. around the swarm, including around corners. Constructs, Elementals, Plants, and Undead are unaffected. Each other creature in the area makes a DC 10 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is incapacitated and its speed is halved for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending both effects on a success.
sections.Printed source: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight, p. 232 (Appendix C).

statBlock.name: Thinnings
statBlock.description: Zybilna’s stick-thin butler. He was away when the palace was frozen and now spies on the League of Malevolence.

sections.Traits: Sneak Attack (once per turn). A weapon hit deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage if Thinnings had advantage on the attack. He can also deal the extra damage if one of his allies is within 5 ft. of the target, that ally is not incapacitated, and the attack does not have disadvantage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two melee attacks.
Shortsword. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Hand Crossbow. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
Change Shape. Thinnings can flatten himself like parchment or return to normal. While flat he can slide beneath doors, roll himself up, or fold himself between the pages of a book.
sections.Bonus actions: Cunning Action. Thinnings can Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a bonus action on his turn.
sections.Servants’ quarters: Thinnings usually hides under or behind a dresser in P15. Passive Wisdom (Perception) 14 spots him during a quick look. A thorough search finds him. A character can coax him into the open by reciting Demitasse’s rhyme and telling him a secret he does not already know. He knows how to end temporal stasis and where the Jabberwock and League of Malevolence are.
sections.Printing note: The printed rules appear at area P15 on p. 182. The local index gives 15 as the page.
sections.Printed source: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight, p. 182 (P15), with the Spy from Monster Manual (2014), p. 349.

statBlock.name: Tin Soldier
statBlock.description: A three-foot suit of armor with an infantryman’s shape. It follows Skabatha’s orders and rushes to investigate disturbances.

sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned.
sections.Traits:
Antimagic Susceptibility. An Antimagic Field leaves the soldier incapacitated while it stays inside. If targeted with Dispel Magic, it must make a Constitution save against the caster’s spell save DC or fall unconscious for 1 minute.
False Appearance. While motionless, the soldier looks like an ordinary suit of armor.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two melee attacks.
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Loomlurch barracks: Six soldiers emerge from L7 when they hear nearby combat, or when Skabatha Nightshade or Pincushion calls. Four others patrol L8 and L12. The six march with an Animated Drum. A soldier that can hear it gains +2 to its damage rolls. If the drum is destroyed, soldiers within 60 ft. are stunned until the end of their next turn.
sections.Animated Drum: Small animated object, AC 16, 25 HP, speed 30 ft., blindsight 30 ft., no effective attacks. Str 6, Dex 14, Con 10, Int 3, Wis 3, Cha 1. Immune to poison and psychic damage and the blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, and poisoned conditions. Its beat carries 60 ft.
sections.Printed source: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight, pp. 115 and 122 (Skabatha’s minions and L7), with the Animated Armor from Monster Manual (2014), p. 19. The adventure changes the armor’s size to Small and gives it 27 (6d6 + 6) hit points.
